2. Appellants are taking exception to the judgment and award dated
 28.09.2017 passed in Lar No.824 of 2006.

3. Appellants are claiming enhancement of rate from Rs.1,80,000/-
 per Hector to 2,00,000/- per Hector for dry land and consequentially
 Rs.1,00,000/- per Hector for pot kharab land.

Learned counsel is placing
 reliance on the judgment of Special Land Acquisition Officer (Iii), Jalgaon &
 Anr. vs. Bhagwat Vithal Sonwane reported in 2009 (4) Mh.L.J., 308.
 (2) 107 Fa 2739 Of 2021
4.

Mr. Sandesh Patil, learned counsel appearing for the respondent-
acquiring body opposes the submissions of the appellants.
It is submitted that

no case is made out by the appellants for enhancing the rate.

The Reference
Court is justified in awarding adequate compensation.

It is further submitted
that interest is made payable from the date of possession which is not in
accordance with the law.
5. I have considered rival submissions of the parties.

Appellants' land
measuring 2 Hector and 22 Are dry land and 0.59 pot kharab has been
acquired for Waghur project.

It was from village Khadgaon, Taluka Jamner,
District Jalgaon.

The Reference Court enhanced the compensation to
Rs.1,80,000/- per Hector for dry land and consequentially Rs.90,000/- per
Hector for pot kharab land.

6. This Court has taken consistent view in a similarly situated
matters in enhancing the compensation to Rs.2,00,000/- per Hector for dry
land and Rs.1,00,000/- for pot kharab land.

The appellants are entitled to the
enhancement on the ground of parity.

The payment of interest shall be in
accordance with the law laid down in State of Maharashtra Vs. Kailash Shiva
Rangari [2016 Air (Bom.)141].
